item: BACKLOG spcc-sensor-curve stage 1 (GO stage 1, director astro-imaging-45, researcher astro-imaging-52); docs/spcc-sensor-curve-z6iii.md sections 1.4-1.6 and 4 (arms B, B', B°)
instrument: scripts/setup/spcc_curves/fetch_sources.sh (curl, sha256-pinned) + convert_curves.py (the database's own utils/process_osc_sensor.py generates the objects; hand-checked against spcc-database-schema.json's required set — jsonschema is not installed in host python3 or /opt/astro-venv); no Siril was run

Nikon_Z_f_380_780_5.json.format: physlight schema 0.1.0: spectral_data.data.main['<nm>'] = [R,G,B], units 'relative', 81 points 380-780 nm at 5 nm; header laboratory/equipment 'wetadigital'/'lightsaber'

Nikon_Z6_ssf.csv.file_commit: dce9021f98bc28942a8f84ca3cdb5e791f3a1931 (2020-09-20, the file's last commit per the GitHub API)
Nikon_Z6_ssf.csv.licence: CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, copyright 2020 Glenn Butcher (README) — converted file installed machine-locally, NOT tracked, NOT redistributed
Nikon_Z6_ssf.csv.format: CSV wavelength,R,G,B; 64 rows 400-715 nm at 5 nm; two-decimal values; README: NIKKOR Z 24-70mm f/4 S, transmissive glass-substrate ruled diffraction grating spectroscope, single image, 2020-08-27, ssftool

conversion.photon_based: v_ph(l) = v_src(l) / l[nm]; then all three channels divided by one global max (max 1.0, inter-channel scale preserved); rounded to 6 significant digits; values.range 1; wavelength units nm. Reason: Siril multiplies the Gaia XP flux by wavelength (photon counting, src/algos/spcc.c flux_to_relcount) and treats the curve as QE; a response per unit incident POWER is QE*lambda/hc, so QE-shape = response/lambda (docs/spcc-sensor-curve-z6iii.md section 1.6)
conversion.energy_as_shipped: source values verbatim (no /lambda, no renormalisation), values.range 1 — model 'Nikon Z f (energy)', the arm B° twin that measures the convention's effect on K
conversion.generator: the database's utils/process_osc_sensor.py fed a 6-column WebPlotDigitizer-style CSV (w,R,w,G,w,B), argv recorded per file below; after generation only dataQualityMarker and comment were overwritten (the generator hard-codes 2 and 'Covers all cameras using this chip'); names kept as generated ('<model> Red/Green/Blue'); no numeric value touched after generation; no is_dslr (whole-camera curves: the body's hot mirror is inside; an is_dslr model would require -osclpf= after the runner's preload)
conversion.wavelength_note: the generator emits wavelengths as floats (380.0 ...); Siril reads numbers

Nikon_Zf.json: https://github.com/AcademySoftwareFoundation/rawtoaces-data/blob/cf6452c3ce44112f6cf3f1c2d7bf6381a4c90638/data/camera/Nikon_Z_f_380_780_5.json (Weta Digital physlight camera SSF, 'lightsaber' rig, doi:10.5281/zenodo.6590768; Apache-2.0)

Nikon_Z6.json: https://github.com/butcherg/ssf-data/blob/dce9021f98bc28942a8f84ca3cdb5e791f3a1931/Nikon/Z6/spectroscope/Nikon_Z6_ssf.csv (Glenn Butcher, DIY transmissive-grating spectroscope + ssftool, 2020-08-27, lens NIKKOR Z 24-70mm f/4 S; CC BY-NC-SA 4.0)

schema_check.method: hand check of the required set: root array of 3; type OSC_SENSOR; model/name/manufacturer/dataSource non-empty strings; dataQualityMarker int 1-5; version int >=1; channel RED/GREEN/BLUE one each; wavelength.value numbers >=0 strictly increasing, units in the enum; values.value finite numbers >=0; values.range >0; 5-2000 points; equal lengths; identical model across the three; is_dslr absent

install_note: three NEW untracked files in the clone's osc_sensors/ (git status: ?? only); the GUI's hard reset (auto_update_spcc, GUI-only; this rig pins it false) reverts tracked files and leaves new ones; the runner's preflight (spcc_run.preflight_spec) accepts all three models with is_dslr False; the database now lists 50 OSC_SENSOR models
premises_untested: which convention the Weta 'relative' values carry (per unit power, i.e. responsivity — assumed, the physlight rendering use case; or per photon): the (energy) twin measures the magnitude of the difference in arm B°, not which is right
that Butcher's ssftool 'powercalibrate' reference makes the Z6 values per unit power (the ssftool README says power compensation; the lamp reference file's provenance is unstated)
that the Nikon Z f / Z6 CFA dyes and hot mirror are those of the Z6 III (IMX820AQJ): assumed by every proxy, measured by no one (docs section 1.4a)

that Siril lists and resolves the three models exactly as written: the runner's preflight reads the same JSON the loader reads, but no Siril run was made here — the worker's arm runs assert the spcc_list block
that dividing by wavelength in nm before the global renormalisation is numerically equivalent to the physical QE shape to 6 significant digits (rounding after normalisation)
that the 5 nm grids interpolate acceptably onto Siril's 2 nm grid (Akima; zero outside 380-780 / 400-715 nm — the Z6 curve is zero for 337-399 nm and 716-1019 nm by construction)
